  "subject": "Senior Software Engineer — Jordan Rivera",
  "body": "Hi Sarah,

I am a senior software engineer in Melbourne, Australia with 8 years building distributed backend systems in Python and PostgreSQL. At Canvatech I led 6 engineers on a payments platform and migrated services to Kubernetes and Docker, cutting deploy time from 30 minutes to 5 minutes.

If Atlassian is hiring for backend or platform engineering, I would welcome a short conversation.

Thanks,
Jordan Rivera"
